adjudication.rationale: Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 14-17, the function checks `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` to decide which schema to use. However, in refreshOAuthTokens.ts, when userId is null, it falls back to calling the local refreshFunction directly (line 16-17). The issue is that parseRefreshTokenResponse doesn't know whether the response came from the sync endpoint or the local refresh - it only checks global env vars. So if APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true but a credential has no userId (causing local refresh fallback), the response will still be parsed with minimumTokenResponseSchema instead of the proper app-specific schema, potentially causing validation issues or accepting malformed responses.
